questions.question: When God spoke the Ten Commandments to Israel from the mountain, why would the people not go up it?

answers.text: They were afraid of the fire
They were too tired to climb
They were waiting for the elders

questions.question: In the first of the Ten Commandments, what did God tell Israel about other gods?

answers.text: They must have no other gods before Him
They may honor other gods in other lands
They must keep other gods outside the camp
